description: BC Wildfire Area Restrictions is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by BC Wildfire Service. British Columbia Area Restrictions are identified as areas that are put into place to help protect public safety and allow fire suppression efforts to continue efficiently. This is outlined under Sec 11(2) of the Wildfire Act. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher BC Wildfire Service. Its tags are AGO, AGOL, ArcGIS Online, Area Restrictions, BC Wildfire. It offers 4 resource(s) in ARCGIS_REST, KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
